parity_symmetry.claim: entry(-m,-n) == entry(m,n), so H_L commutes with J:(Jv)_n=v_{-n}

offdiagonal_sign_census.note: count of positive/negative/zero strictly-upper off-diagonal entries; gauge_balanced = exists diagonal D in {+-1} with all off-diagonals of DHD of one sign
offdiagonal_sign_census.reading: zeta off-diagonals essentially all POSITIVE (wrong sign for bottom-state Perron-Frobenius, and a uniformly-positive off-diagonal pattern on >=3 modes is not gauge-reducible to nonpositive); plant off-diagonals genuinely MIXED sign. Neither build admits the PF sign structure.

parity_resolved_low_spectrum.note: lowest eigenvalues of even and odd sectors, dps=90 (E78.1b)

zeta.reading: ALL low eigenvalues (both sectors, multiple indices) collapse geometrically toward 0. mu_L=inf spec -> 0; ground gap vanishes.

plant.reading: even-sector ground converges to an isolated NEGATIVE eigenvalue ~ -1.73; odd-sector ground ~ -1.59; both isolated with an order-one gap. mu_L simple and isolated for the plant.

ground_gap_dichotomy.note: global ground gap g_N = (2nd smallest) - (smallest) and g_N/g_{N-2} (E78.1c, dps=70)
ground_gap_dichotomy.reading: zeta ground gap collapses GEOMETRICALLY (ratio ~1e-4 per 2 modes); plant ground gap is ORDER-ONE stable (ratio ~0.85). ~4 orders of magnitude difference in collapse rate -- robust, matches E77.7f N<=18 data.

conclusions.PF_mechanism: DEAD for both builds: no diagonal +-1 gauge makes B_L single-signed; zeta off-diagonals are uniformly positive (wrong sign), plant mixed. The planner's Perron-Frobenius route to item 4 does not exist.
conclusions.item4_build_neutrality: REFUTED as posed. 'dim E_L=1 with isolation/gap at mu_L' is build-DISCRIMINATING: it holds cleanly for the plant (isolated simple ground state) and degenerates for zeta (ground gap -> 0). Simplicity is not the build-neutral object subclause (e) requires.
conclusions.detector_status: The discriminating quantity is the ground-state gap at mu_L, which by E77.7f equals the LP/BTG divergence signature (gap->0 <=> S_N->infinity <=> Weyl contraction). Being order-one build-discriminating, it is a DETECTOR under the E77.7az / E72.16 gate, not an admissible forcing mechanism.
conclusions.flag_for_review: The plant's order-one-stable ground gap means S_N(mu_L^plant) need not diverge at the plant's OWN mu_L -- Outcome-B-flavored evidence. Presented as data for Fable-5; not a unilateral overturn of the settled E77.7az gate.
